verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents registrable outbound HTTP POST webhooks in two places. The Marketing API sends audience events such as subscriptions, email changes and campaign sending, with signature verification. Mailchimp Transactional sends message events (send, bounce, delivered, open, click, spam, unsub, reject) and has test/debug guidance. Missing for 10: webhook enablement on the Marketing side is gated to Standard/Premium plans, no explicit evidence of registering webhooks programmatically via API rather than by entering a URL, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
